verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is marketing copy saying busywork tasks like finding subscriptions and matching invoices to payments are "described once, done automatically, reviewed by you," which implies recurring execution but never mentions an explicit schedule. Custom categorization rules are a form of standing automation, not scheduled jobs. Missing for 10: an explicit scheduler or cron-like recurrence settings, documentation of recurring workflows or jobs, schedule management via the API or MCP, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
